renderOrder: Wave 1: 00-style-master (3 jobs) MUST complete and PASS Visual_Target_Score (>= 80, no weighted dim < 50%, State coverage = PASS, QA_Owner signed) BEFORE any Wave 2 job runs.

Wave 2..18: downstream modules in approved Priority_Owner order; one module's 3 jobs run as a wave, in the sequence: 01-dashboard, 03-session, 02-course, 05-vocabulary, 06-grammar, 07-listening, 08-speaking, 09-reading, 10-writing, 04-review, 11-exam, 12-rewards, 13-missions, 14-chat, 15-profile, 16-teacher, 17-admin.
perJob: Read promptSource for the canonical Fuxie Bright Sky prompt block + module-specific cues + viewport spec.
Render PNG at the exact viewport. Replace the 1x1 transparent placeholder at outputPath in place; do not create extra files.
Update generation-prompt.md Reviewer (Pack_Owner name) and Date (ISO 8601) in the SAME change set as the rendered PNG (Requirement 12 AC 6).
Pack_Owner + Illustrator / 3D Mascot Artist run originality co-review per Requirement 9 AC 1, 7 before the mock is treated as a visual target.

QA_Owner scores Visual_Target_Score per module after all 3 jobs for that module land; record per-dim scores + State coverage gate result + total + sign-off in qa-checklist.md AND in README audit table within the same change set.
doNot: Do not introduce any mock-state-*.png variant; V0 supports only a single mock-state.png per module.
Do not modify apps/web/..., production routes, CI configs, or module implementation code.
Do not mark any module PASS until real PNGs exist and QA_Owner has signed.
